source: CI: mean of 3 manual quality-gate runs on ubuntu-24.04 after the hyphen/singular matching fix (af90c8f): PR #7 at ed36205 86.9, main at a9fac4a 88.1 and 86.3; 0 errors each
note: Recalibrated after the fact-matching fix ("30-day" and "30 day" now count for "30 days"). The earlier baseline was 88.1 (ubuntu-latest at 889c146: 89.0, 87.7, 87.7, old matcher). The fix can only raise a score on the same answers, so the lower mean reflects run-to-run variation on the CPU runner, not the matcher. Recalibrate when the model, embedding model, or golden questions change.
